moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: Inflicts a burn on the foe with intense fire.
moves.effect: Burns the target.

moves.name: Memento
moves.description: The user faints and lowers the foe’s abilities.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: Boosts ATTACK when burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: A powerful loyalty attack. The user flinches if hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Smelling Salts
moves.description: Powerful against paralyzed foes, but also heals them.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.description: Draws attention to make foes attack only the user.
moves.effect: Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target. This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.description: The type of attack varies depending on the location.
moves.effect: Uses another move chosen according to the terrain. Terrain | Selected move ------------------------- | ------------------ Building | Tri Attack Cave | Rock Slide Deep water | Hydro Pump Desert | Earthquake Grass | Seed Bomb Mountain | Rock Slide Road | Earthquake Shallow water | Hydro Pump Snow | Blizzard Tall grass | Seed Bomb Electric Terrain | Thunderbolt Grassy Terrain | Energy Ball Misty Terrain | Moonblast In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | Selected move -------------- | ------------------ Courtyard | Tri Attack Crystal | Rock Slide Gateway | Hydro Pump Magma | Rock Slide Main Street | Tri Attack Neon | Tri Attack Stargazer | Rock Slide Sunny Park | Seed Bomb Sunset | Earthquake Waterfall | Seed Bomb This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: Charges power to boost the electric move used next.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: Taunts the foe into only using attack moves.
moves.effect: Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging. Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used. Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: Boosts the power of the recipient’s moves.
moves.effect: Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: Tricks the foe into trading held items.
moves.effect: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: Mimics the target and copies its special ability.
moves.effect: User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target has Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: A wish that restores HP. It takes time to work.
moves.effect: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP. If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP. If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

moves.name: Assist
moves.description: Attacks randomly with one of the partner’s moves.
moves.effect: Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random. Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used. If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail. This move will not select Assist, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Phantom Force Protect, Quick Guard, Roar Shadow Force, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wide Guard. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: Lays roots that restore HP. The user can’t switch out.
moves.effect: Prevents the user from switching out. User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them. Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user. The user cannot use Magnet Rise. The user may still use U-turn to leave the field. This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: Boosts strength sharply, but lowers abilities.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.description: Reflects special effects back to the attacker.
moves.effect: The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user. Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected. Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: Recycles a used item for one more use.
moves.effect: User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field. The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again. If the user is holding an item, this move fails. Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.description: An attack that gains power if injured by the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: Destroys barriers such as REFLECT and causes damage.
moves.effect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: Lulls the foe into yawning, then sleeping next turn.
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail. If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail. Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: Knocks down the foe’s held item to prevent its use.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: Gains power if the user’s HP is lower than the foe’s HP.
moves.effect: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.description: The higher the user’s HP, the more damage caused.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user swaps special abilities with the target.
moves.effect: User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: Prevents foes from using moves known by the user.
moves.effect: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field. This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted. If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user’s moves when this move is used, this move will fail.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.description: Heals poisoning, paralysis, or a burn.
moves.effect: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.

moves.name: Grudge
moves.description: If the user faints, deletes the PP of the final move.
moves.effect: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0. End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: Steals the effects of the move the foe uses next.
moves.effect: The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself. Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag. If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move’s effect. If the user steals Psych Up, it will target the Pokémon that used Psych Up. If the user was the original target of Psych Up, and the Pokémon that originally used it’s affected by Pressure, it will only lose 1 PP. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: An attack with effects that vary by location.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to inflict an effect chosen according to the terrain. Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Building | Paralyzes target Cave | Makes target flinch Deep water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Desert | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Grass | Puts target to sleep Mountain | Makes target flinch Road | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Shallow water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Snow | Freezes target Tall grass | Puts target to sleep In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Courtyard | Paralyzes target Crystal | Makes target flinch Gateway | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Magma | Makes target flinch Main Street | Paralyzes target Neon | Paralyzes target Stargazer | Makes target flinch Sunny Park | Puts target to sleep Sunset | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Waterfall | Puts target to sleep

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: Dives underwater the first turn and strikes next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. During the immune turn, Surf, and Whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.description: Straight-arm punches that strike the foe 2 to 5 times.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Camouflage
moves.description: Alters the POKéMON’s type depending on the location.
moves.effect: User’s type changes according to the terrain. Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Building | Normal Cave | Rock Desert | Ground Grass | Grass Mountain | Rock Ocean | Water Pond | Water Road | Ground Snow | Ice Tall grass | Grass In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Courtyard | Normal Crystal | Rock Gateway | Water Magma | Rock Main Street | Normal Neon | Normal Stargazer | Rock Sunny Park | Grass Sunset | Ground Waterfall | Grass

moves.name: Tail Glow
moves.description: Flashes a light that sharply raises SP. ATK.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by three stages.

moves.name: Luster Purge
moves.description: Attacks with a burst of light. May lower SP. DEF.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Mist Ball
moves.description: Attacks with a flurry of down. May lower SP. ATK.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.description: Envelops the foe with down to sharply reduce ATTACK.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: Confuses all POKéMON on the scene.
moves.effect: Confuses all targets.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.description: A kick with a high critical- hit ratio. May cause a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.description: Covers the user in mud to raise electrical resistance.
moves.effect: Electric moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Ice Ball
moves.description: A 5-turn attack that gains power on successive hits.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

moves.name: Needle Arm
moves.description: Attacks with thorny arms. May cause flinching.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.description: Slacks off and restores half the maximum HP.
moves.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: A loud attack that uses sound waves to injure.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.description: A sharp-fanged attack. May badly poison the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to badly poison the target.

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.description: Tears at the foe with sharp claws. May lower DEFENSE.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.description: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.description: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.description: Fires a meteor-like punch. May raise ATTACK.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: An attack that may shock the foe into flinching.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: The move’s type and power change with the weather.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move. Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.

moves.name: Aromatherapy
moves.description: Heals all status problems with a soothing scent.
moves.effect: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: Feigns crying to sharply lower the foe’s SP. DEF.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: Hacks with razorlike wind. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Odor Sleuth
moves.description: Negates the foe’s efforts to heighten evasiveness.
moves.effect: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Stops the foe from moving with rocks and cuts SPEED.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: A powdery attack that may raise abilities.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: Emits a horrible screech that sharply lowers SP. DEF.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Grass Whistle
moves.description: Lulls the foe into sleep with a pleasant melody.
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: Makes the foe laugh to lower ATTACK and DEFENSE.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.description: Raises DEFENSE and SP. DEF with a mystic power.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: Inflicts more damage if the user’s HP is high.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.description: A strange beam attack that may confuse the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.description: An unavoidable punch that is thrown from shadows.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: Attacks with a peculiar power. May cause flinching.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Sky Uppercut
moves.description: An uppercut thrown as if leaping into the sky.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: Traps and hurts the foe in quicksand for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description: A chilling attack that causes fainting if it hits.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: Attacks with muddy water. May lower accuracy.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row to strike the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: An extremely speedy and unavoidable attack.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: Attacks the foe by firing 2 to 5 icicles in a row.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: Hardens the body’s surface to sharply raise DEFENSE.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: Blocks the foe’s way to prevent escape.
moves.effect: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: Howls to raise the spirit and boosts ATTACK.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: Slashes the foe with sharp claws.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.description: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: Bulks up the body to boost both ATTACK and DEFENSE.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: Bounces up, then down the next turn. May paralyze.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: Hurls mud at the foe and reduces SPEED.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: Has a high critical-hit ratio. May also poison.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Covet
moves.description: Cutely begs to obtain an item held by the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.description: A life-risking tackle that slightly hurts the user.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: Attacks with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.description: The user becomes soaked to raise resistance to fire.
moves.effect: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: Raises SP. ATK and SP. DEF by focusing the mind.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: Slashes with a sharp leaf. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.description: A mystical dance that ups ATTACK and SPEED.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: Hurls boulders at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: A fast and unavoidable electric attack.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: Attacks with ultrasonic waves. May confuse the foe
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Doom Desire
moves.description: Summons strong sunlight to attack 2 turns later.
moves.effect: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Psycho Boost
moves.description: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.
moves.effect: For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop. Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes. Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect. *Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

moves.name: Miracle Eye
moves.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
moves.effect: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Wake-Up Slap
moves.description: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.
moves.effect: User faints. Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry. The berry is consumed. If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.
moves.effect: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.
moves.effect: Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages. The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages. If no stat is eligible, this move will fail. If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.description: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.
moves.effect: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn. Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

moves.name: Embargo
moves.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
moves.effect: Target cannot use its held item for five turns. If the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail. This effect is passed by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail. This move ignores Sticky Hold. If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.
moves.effect: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target.

moves.name: Trump Card
moves.description: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. PP remaining | Power ------------ | ----: 4 or more | 40 3 | 50 2 | 60 1 | 80 0 | 200 If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

moves.name: Heal Block
moves.description: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.
moves.effect: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled. Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.

moves.name: Wring Out
moves.description: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.
moves.effect: The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.
moves.effect: The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Lucky Chant
moves.description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.
moves.effect: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.

moves.name: Me First
moves.description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.
moves.effect: If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power. If the target moves before the user, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
moves.effect: Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user. This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.
moves.effect: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.
moves.effect: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.

moves.name: Punishment
moves.description: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.
moves.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia. If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. This move is not affected by Iron Fist.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.
moves.effect: Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity. If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed. Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field. This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar. Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

moves.name: Heart Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the foe.
moves.effect: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.
moves.effect: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves. If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail. This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Force Palm
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target paralyzed.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.description: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.
moves.effect: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.description: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Clears away fog. Removes the effects of Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the target’s side of the field. If the target is protected by Mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect. Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.description: An inferno of scarlet flames washes over all Pokémon in battle. It may also inflict burns.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Rock Wrecker
moves.description: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.description: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.
moves.effect: Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

moves.name: Chatter
moves.description: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the foe.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion. If the user is not a Chatot, this move will not cause confusion. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Judgment
moves.description: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the foe to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Attack Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Defend Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to make a living shield, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Heal Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
moves.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.description: The user delivers a life-endangering head butt at full power. The user also takes terrible damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.description: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.description: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Lunar Dance
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.
moves.effect: User faints. Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.description: The foe is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the foe has left.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

moves.name: Magma Storm
moves.description: The foe becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for two to five turns.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Dark Void
moves.description: The foe is dragged into a world of total darkness that puts it to sleep.
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.description: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Shadow Force
moves.description: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe used Protect.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Hone Claws
moves.description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.
moves.effect: Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Guard Split
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target’s.
moves.effect: Averages the user’s unmodified Defense with the target’s unmodified Defense; the value becomes the unmodified Defense for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Defense is averaged the same way.

moves.name: Power Split
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target’s.
moves.effect: Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way. This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as Flower Gift during Sunny Day.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.

moves.name: Autotomize
moves.description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages. Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack.

moves.name: Rage Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.
moves.effect: Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target. This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Telekinesis
moves.description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
moves.effect: For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to Ground damage. Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect. This effect is removed by Gravity. If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail.

moves.name: Magic Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns (including this one), passive effects of held items are ignored, and Pokémon will not use their held items.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage. This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage. If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Flame Burst
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If this move successfully hits the target, any Pokémon adjacent to the target are damaged for 1/16 their max HP.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.description: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

moves.name: Synchronoise
moves.description: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Only Pokémon that share a type with the user will take damage from this move.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s Speed compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 150. User’s Speed | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s Speed | 60 Up to 3× the target’s Speed | 80 Up to 4× the target’s Speed | 120 More than 4× the target’s Speed | 150

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.
moves.effect: Changes the target to pure Water-type until it leaves the field. If the target has Multitype, this move will fail.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.description: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Coil
moves.description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.description: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage is calculated using the target’s attacking stat rather than the user’s.

moves.name: Simple Beam
moves.description: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.
moves.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.description: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.
moves.effect: Changes the target’s ability to match the user’s. This effect ends when the target leaves battle.

moves.name: After You
moves.description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
moves.effect: The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If Round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled. After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority. Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual.

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If any friendly Pokémon used this move earlier this turn or on the previous turn, that use’s power is added to this move’s power, to a maximum of 200.

moves.name: Chip Away
moves.description: Looking for an opening, the user strikes continually. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Clear Smog
moves.description: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. All of the target’s stat modifiers are reset to zero.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.
moves.effect: Moves with priority greater than 0 will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.
moves.effect: User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it. If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.description: The user breaks its shell, lowering its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raising Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each. Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.description: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.effect: Heals the target for half its max HP.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power.

moves.name: Sky Drop
moves.description: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act. On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect. If the target is Flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage. Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect. Gust and Twister will additionally have double power. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during this effect. Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. *Bug*: If Gravity is used during a double or triple battle while this move is in effect, this move is not correctly canceled on the target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As this move prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.description: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.description: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random. If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

moves.name: Incinerate
moves.description: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, it’s destroyed and cannot be used in response to this move.

moves.name: Quash
moves.description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
moves.effect: Forces the target to act last this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user has no held item, this move has double power.

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.description: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.
moves.effect: User’s type changes to match the target’s.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.description: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon fainted on the previous turn, this move has double power.

moves.name: Final Gambit
moves.description: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to the user’s HP.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.

moves.name: Bestow
moves.description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
moves.effect: Transfers the user’s held item to the target. If the user has no held item, or the target already has a held item, this move will fail.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Water Pledge
moves.description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Grass Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one).

moves.name: Fire Pledge
moves.description: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, its damage increases into a vast sea of fire.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Water Pledge earlier this turn, moves used by any friendly Pokémon have doubled effect chance for four turns (including this one).

moves.name: Grass Pledge
moves.description: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fire Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon will take 1/8 their max HP in damage at the end of every turn for four turns (including this one).

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon’s Speed stat is reduced.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Frost Breath
