moves.description: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random. If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures and attacks opposing Pokémon by using an electric net. It reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Dual Chop
moves.description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Heart Stamp
moves.description: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Horn Leech
moves.description: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Sacred Sword
moves.description: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Razor Shell
moves.description: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Heat Crash
moves.description: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

moves.name: Leaf Tornado
moves.description: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Steamroller
moves.description: The user crushes its targets by rolling over them with its rolled-up body. This attack may make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising the user’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.

moves.name: Night Daze
moves.description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Psystrike
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

moves.name: Head Charge
moves.description: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. It also damages the user a little.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Gear Grind
moves.description: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Searing Shot
moves.description: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Techno Blast
moves.description: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

moves.name: Relic Song
moves.description: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to put the target to sleep. If the user is a Meloetta, it will toggle between Aria and Pirouette Forme.

moves.name: Secret Sword
moves.description: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn does physical damage to the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

moves.name: Glaciate
moves.description: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This attack reduces the targets’ Speed stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Bolt Strike
moves.description: The user charges its target, surrounding itself with a great amount of electricity. It may leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Blue Flare
moves.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Fiery Dance
moves.description: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Freeze Shock
moves.description: On the second turn, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice. It may leave the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. User charges for one turn before attacking.

moves.name: Ice Burn
moves.description: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the target. This may leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. User charges for one turn before attacking.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the target. It may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: V-create
moves.description: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. It lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Fusion Flare
moves.description: The user brings down a giant flame. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fusion Bolt earlier this turn, this move has double power.

moves.name: Fusion Bolt
moves.description: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous flame.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fusion Flare earlier this turn, this move has double power.

moves.name: Flying Press
moves.description: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the purposes of type effectiveness, this move is both Fighting- and Flying-type: its final effectiveness is determined by multiplying the effectiveness of each type against each of the target’s types. For all other purposes, this move is pure Fighting-type. If this move’s type is changed, its Fighting typing is overwritten, and its secondary type remains Flying. If the target has used Minimize since entering battle, this move has double power and will never miss.

moves.name: Mat Block
moves.description: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.
moves.effect: Protects all friendly Pokémon from damaging moves. Only works on the first turn after the user is sent out.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used if the user has eaten a berry since the beginning of the battle. After the user eats a berry, it may use this move any number of times until the end of the battle, even if it switches out. Eating a held berry, eating a berry via Bug Bite or Pluck, or being the target of a Flung berry will enable this move. Feeding a Pokémon a berry from the bag or using Natural Gift will not. If the trainer chooses this move when it cannot be used, the choice is rejected outright and the trainer must choose another move.

moves.name: Rototiller
moves.description: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of Grass-type Pokémon.
moves.effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all Grass Pokémon in battle.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.description: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stat upon switching into battle.
moves.effect: Shoots a web over the opponents’ side of the field, which lowers the Speed of any opposing Pokémon that enters the field by one stage. Pokémon in the air, such as Flying-types and those with Levitate, are unaffected. Rapid Spin removes Sticky Web from the user’s side of the field; Defog removes it from both sides.

moves.name: Fell Stinger
moves.description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat rises sharply.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.description: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
moves.effect: Adds Ghost to the target’s types.

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Ion Deluge
moves.description: The user disperses electrically charged particles, which changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
moves.effect: Changes all Pokémon’s Normal moves to Electric moves for the rest of the turn.

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by those hit.
moves.effect: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.

moves.name: Forest’s Curse
moves.description: The user puts a forest curse on the target. Afflicted targets are now Grass type as well.
moves.effect: Adds Grass to the target’s types.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.description: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. This move is super-effective against the Water type. The target’s other type will affect damage as usual. If this move’s type is changed, it remains super-effective against Water regardless of its type.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion.

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches with a party Pokémon.
moves.effect: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage. Makes the user switch out.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
moves.effect: Inverts the target’s stat modifiers.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user steals the target’s energy with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
moves.effect: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Crafty Shield
moves.description: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.
moves.effect: Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves for the rest of the turn. Unlike other blocking moves, this move may be used consecutively without its chance of success falling.

moves.name: Flower Shield
moves.description: The user raises the Defense stat of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
moves.effect: Raises the Defense of all Grass Pokémon in battle.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground under everyone’s feet to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn.
moves.effect: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Energy Ball.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: The user covers the ground under everyone’s feet with mist for five turns. This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions.
moves.effect: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Moonblast.

moves.name: Electrify
moves.description: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.
moves.effect: Changes the target’s move’s type to Electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Fairy Wind
moves.description: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Fairy Lock
moves.description: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
moves.effect: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.

moves.name: King’s Shield
moves.description: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also harshly lowers the Attack stat of any attacker who makes direct contact.
moves.effect: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact. Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

moves.name: Play Nice
moves.description: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Confide
moves.description: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Diamond Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by two stages for each target hit.

moves.name: Steam Eruption
moves.description: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Hyperspace Hole
moves.description: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This also hits a target using Protect or Detect.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.description: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.description: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker who makes direct contact.
moves.effect: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.

moves.name: Aromatic Mist
moves.description: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
moves.effect: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.

moves.name: Powder
moves.description: The user covers the target in a powder that explodes and damages the target if it uses a Fire-type move.
moves.effect: Explodes if the target uses a Fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.

moves.name: Geomancy
moves.description: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.
moves.effect: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Magnetic Flux
moves.description: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which raises the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
moves.effect: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

moves.name: Happy Hour
moves.description: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
moves.effect: Doubles prize money. Stacks with a held item. Only works once per battle.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user electrifies the ground under everyone’s feet for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.
moves.effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Celebrate
moves.description: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
moves.effect: Does nothing.

moves.name: Hold Hands
moves.description: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
moves.effect: Does nothing.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers its Attack stat. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Hold Back
moves.description: The user holds back when it attacks and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

moves.name: Infestation
moves.description: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this time.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Power-Up Punch
moves.description: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Oblivion Wing
moves.description: The user absorbs its target’s HP. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
moves.effect: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Thousand Arrows
moves.description: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Grounds the target until it leaves battle. Ignores levitation effects and the immunity of Flying-type Pokémon.

moves.name: Thousand Waves
moves.description: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those hit can’t flee from battle.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

moves.name: Land’s Wrath
moves.description: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Light of Ruin
moves.description: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Origin Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Precipice Blades
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Ascent
moves.description: After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by dropping out of the sky at high speeds, although it lowers its own Defense and Sp. Def in the process.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Hyperspace Fury
moves.description: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This attack lowers the user’s Defense.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

moves.name: Breakneck Blitz
moves.description: The user builds up its momentum using its Z-Power and crashes into the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Breakneck Blitz
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: All-Out Pummeling
moves.description: The user rams an energy orb created by its Z-Power into the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: All-Out Pummeling
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Supersonic Skystrike
moves.description: The user soars up with its Z-Power and plummets toward the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Supersonic Skystrike
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Acid Downpour
moves.description: The user creates a poisonous swamp using its Z-Power and sinks the target into it at full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Acid Downpour
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Tectonic Rage
moves.description: The user burrows deep into the ground and slams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Tectonic Rage
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Continental Crush
moves.description: The user summons a huge rock mountain using its Z-Power and drops it onto the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Continental Crush
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Savage Spin-Out
moves.description: The user binds the target with full force with threads of silk that the user spits using its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Savage Spin-Out
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Never-Ending Nightmare
moves.description: Deep-seated grudges summoned by the user’s Z-Power trap the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Never-Ending Nightmare
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Corkscrew Crash
moves.description: The user spins very fast and rams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Corkscrew Crash
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Inferno Overdrive
moves.description: The user breathes a stream of intense fire toward the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Inferno Overdrive
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Hydro Vortex
moves.description: The user creates a huge whirling current using its Z-Power to swallow the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Hydro Vortex
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bloom Doom
moves.description: The user collects energy from plants using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bloom Doom
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Gigavolt Havoc
moves.description: The user hits the target with a powerful electric current collected by its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Gigavolt Havoc
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shattered Psyche
moves.description: The user controls the target with its Z-Power and hurts the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shattered Psyche
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Subzero Slammer
moves.description: The user dramatically drops the temperature using its Z-Power and freezes the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Subzero Slammer
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Devastating Drake
moves.description: The user materializes its aura using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Devastating Drake
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Black Hole Eclipse
moves.description: The user gathers dark energy using its Z-Power and sucks the target into it. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Black Hole Eclipse
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Twinkle Tackle
moves.description: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Twinkle Tackle
moves.description: Dummy Data
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Catastropika
moves.description: The user, Pikachu, surrounds itself with the maximum amount of electricity using its Z-Power and pounces on its target with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shore Up
moves.description: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
moves.effect: Heals the user for ½ its max HP. During a Sandstorm, the healing is increased to ⅔.

moves.name: First Impression
moves.description: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

moves.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.description: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn. If a Pokémon attempts to use a move that makes contact with the user, that Pokémon will be poisoned. This move’s chance of success halves every time it’s used consecutively with any other protection move.

moves.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.description: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent the target from escaping.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.description: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be healed by the touch of these bubbles.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a burn and takes damage from this move, its burn is healed.

moves.name: Ice Hammer
moves.description: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Floral Healing
moves.description: The user restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.
moves.effect: Heals the target for ½ its max HP. If Grassy Terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.description: The user restores its HP by the same amount as the target’s Attack stat. It also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect. If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail. In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light’s energy, attacking the target on the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.description: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Spotlight
moves.description: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.
moves.effect: For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead.

moves.name: Toxic Thread
moves.description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.effect: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Laser Focus
moves.description: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
moves.effect: The user’s next move will result in a critical hit.

moves.name: Gear Up
moves.description: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
moves.effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
moves.effect: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage. If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.

moves.name: Anchor Shot
moves.description: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
moves.effect: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Fire Lash
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Power Trip
moves.description: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the move’s power.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.description: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation. If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
moves.effect: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Purify
moves.description: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.
moves.effect: Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP. If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail.

moves.name: Revelation Dance
moves.description: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user’s type determines the type of this move.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. This move’s type matches the user’s first type, if any; otherwise, it’s typeless.

moves.name: Core Enforcer
moves.description: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.description: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Instruct
moves.description: The user instructs the target to use the target’s last move again.
moves.effect: The target immediately uses its most recently-used move. This is independent of the target’s normal action for the turn (i.e., it may end up moving twice), but otherwise functions as usual, including deduction of PP. This effect works for disabled moves and ignores Torment.

moves.name: Beak Blast
moves.description: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it’s heating up its beak results in a burn.
moves.effect: Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal. Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned. The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move.

moves.name: Clanging Scales
moves.description: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack the opposing Pokémon. The user’s Defense stat goes down after the attack.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Dragon Hammer
moves.description: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
moves.effect: Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns. If the weather is not Hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of Cloud Nine or Air Lock, this move will fail. Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½. (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.)

moves.name: Sinister Arrow Raid
moves.description: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows using its Z-Power and shoots the target with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Malicious Moonsault
moves.description: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Oceanic Operetta
moves.description: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of water using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Guardian of Alola
moves.description: The user, the Land Spirit Pokémon, obtains Alola’s energy using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. This reduces the target’s HP greatly.
moves.effect: Inflicts direct damage equal to ¾ of the target’s remaining HP.

moves.name: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Stoked Sparksurfer
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Pulverizing Pancake
moves.description: Z-Power brings out the true capabilities of the user, Snorlax. The Pokémon moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Extreme Evoboost
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages each.

moves.name: Genesis Supernova
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mew, attacks the target with full force. The terrain will be charged with psychic energy.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then (if successful) changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Shell Trap
moves.description: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on the opposing Pokémon.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Fleur Cannon
moves.description: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.effect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

moves.name: Shadow Bone
moves.description: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Accelerock
moves.description: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Prismatic Laser
moves.description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can’t move on the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Spectral Thief
moves.description: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
moves.effect: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage. Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target. Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal.

moves.name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moves.name: Moongeist Beam
moves.description: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

moves.name: Zing Zap
moves.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target, giving it an electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Nature’s Madness
moves.description: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
moves.effect: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

moves.name: Multi-Attack
moves.description: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

moves.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Mind Blown
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

moves.name: Plasma Fists
moves.description: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
moves.effect: After inflicting damage, all Normal-type moves become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn, including status moves. This effect is applied after move type-changing abilities, such as Pixilate and Normalize.

moves.name: Photon Geyser
moves.description: The user attacks a target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Light That Burns the Sky
moves.description: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage— whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma. This move ignores the target’s Ability.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage using either Attack or Special Attack stat, whichever is higher. Determining which stat is used takes into account stat changes but not held items or abilities.

moves.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moves.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moves.name: Let’s Snuggle Forever
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Splintered Stormshards
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage and removes any terrain present on the battlefield.

moves.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
moves.description: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user’s stats.
moves.effect: Inflicts sound-based damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. The user’s stats are not raised if the move fails to damage any opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Zippy Zap
moves.description: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Splishy Splash
moves.description: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Floaty Fall
moves.description: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Pika Papow
moves.description: The more Pikachu loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bouncy Bubble
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Buzzy Buzz
moves.description: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Sizzly Slide
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also leaves the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Glitzy Glow
moves.description: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s special moves.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Baddy Bad
moves.description: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s physical moves.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Sappy Seed
moves.description: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. The seeds drain the target’s HP every turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Freezy Frost
moves.description: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Sparkly Swirl
moves.description: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also heals all status conditions of the user’s party.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Veevee Volley
moves.description: The more Eevee loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Double Iron Bash
moves.description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Max Guard
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.effect: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.description: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.effect: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Snipe Shot
moves.description: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
moves.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

moves.name: Jaw Lock
moves.description: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage, then prevents you and the target from switching out. The user or target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. If they do, the effect ends.

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.
moves.effect: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.

moves.name: No Retreat
moves.description: This move raises all the user’s stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
moves.effect: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.description: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target’s Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.
moves.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

moves.name: Magic Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.
moves.effect: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is Arceus, Silvally, or is already only a Psychic type.

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.
moves.effect: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
moves.effect: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry.

moves.name: Octolock
moves.description: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
moves.effect: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field.

moves.name: Bolt Beak
moves.description: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
moves.effect: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

moves.name: Fishious Rend
moves.description: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
moves.effect: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

moves.name: Court Change
moves.description: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
moves.effect: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

moves.name: Max Flare
moves.description: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.
moves.effect: Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Max Flutterby
moves.description: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: If this move hits, lower the Special Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Lightning
moves.description: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.

moves.name: Max Strike
moves.description: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Speed stat.
moves.effect: If this move hits, lower the Speed of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Knuckle
moves.description: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.
moves.effect: If this move hits, raise the Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Phantasm
moves.description: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: If this move hits, lower the Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Hailstorm
moves.description: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.
moves.effect: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

moves.name: Max Ooze
moves.description: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.
moves.effect: If this move hits, raise the Special Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Geyser
moves.description: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.
moves.effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Max Airstream
moves.description: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.
moves.effect: If this move hits, raise the Speed of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Starfall
moves.description: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Moonblast.

moves.name: Max Wyrmwind
moves.description: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.effect: If this move hits, lower the Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Mindstorm
moves.description: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.
moves.effect: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

moves.name: Max Rockfall
moves.description: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.
moves.effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

moves.name: Max Quake
moves.description: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.
moves.effect: If this move hits, raise the Special Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Darkness
moves.description: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: If this move hits, lower the Special Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

moves.name: Max Overgrowth
moves.description: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns.
moves.effect: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Energy Ball.

moves.name: Max Steelspike
moves.description: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.
moves.effect: If this move hits, raise the Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.description: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.
moves.effect: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.
moves.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

moves.name: Decorate
moves.description: The user sharply raises the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
moves.effect: Raise the targets Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Drum Beating
moves.description: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum’s roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.description: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Pyro Ball
moves.description: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Behemoth Blade
moves.description: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.effect: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Behemoth Bash
moves.description: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.effect: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Aura Wheel
moves.description: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move’s type changes depending on the user’s form.
moves.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. Fails unless the user is Hangry Mode or Full Belly Mode Morpeko.

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Branch Poke
moves.description: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Overdrive
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Apple Acid
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.effect: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Grav Apple
moves.description: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.description: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target’s spirit. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Strange Steam
moves.description: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon in the battle.
moves.effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Obstruct
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.
moves.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn. If this blocks a contact move, the user has their Defense lowered by 2 stages.

moves.name: False Surrender
moves.description: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Meteor Assault
moves.description: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Eternabeam
moves.description: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
moves.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. This move’s power goes up and damages all opposing Pokémon on Psychic Terrain.
moves.effect: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.
moves.effect: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.
moves.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.

moves.name: Shell Side Arm
moves.description: This move inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. This may also poison the target.
moves.effect: Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target. If the damage is tied, it is randomly chosen. This calculation ignores any modifiers other than stat stages.

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move’s power is increased on Misty Terrain.
moves.effect: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%. Fails if any active Pokemon has the ability Damp.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.
moves.effect: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move’s power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.
moves.effect: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.description: The user utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power changes depending on the terrain when it’s used.
moves.effect: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
moves.effect: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.
moves.effect: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.description: The user attacks the target by controlling the target’s item. The move fails if the target doesn’t have an item.
moves.effect: Fails if the target has no held item.

moves.name: Corrosive Gas
moves.description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
moves.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses. Skill Link does not apply.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Jungle Healing
moves.description: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and healing any status conditions of itself and its ally Pokémon in battle.
